desk.name: Riverside Housing Co-op, residents' complaints
categories: Repairs inside a flat: heating, hot water, plumbing, electrics, windows or doors
Noise or behaviour of other residents or their visitors
Rent, service charges or billing mistakes

complaints.radiator: The radiator in my bedroom has been stone cold for a week and the boiler pressure keeps dropping below one bar, flat 4B.
complaints.noise: My upstairs neighbour in flat 5B plays loud music past one in the morning every Friday and Saturday, and it shakes my ceiling.
complaints.sponsor: Could the co-op sponsor my son's under-twelves football team this season? They need new kit and a minibus for away games.
complaints.billing: My October service charge was taken twice from my bank account, once on the first and again on the third of the month.

answers.radiator: An engineer will visit flat 4B on Thursday morning to repressurise the boiler and bleed the bedroom radiator.
answers.late: Sorry for the delay. We have written to flat 5B about the music and will follow up after the weekend.
